structures.name: Andy Chambers log cabin

form.plan: Square overall plan formed by a central side-gable log component and full-length shed-roof porches on the west and east elevations.
form.walls: Log bearing walls with square-notched corners and cement daubing.
form.roof: Wood shingles on the central side-gable roof, both shed roofs and gable ends.
form.front: West elevation; open shed porch with a four-course log quarter-wall and log columns.

recognition_cues: Full-length west and east shed porches
Open west porch and enclosed/screened east porch
Five-plank front door north of centre and one window south of centre
Centered ground-floor and small attic windows in both gable ends
Square-notched logs with pale cement daubing

lod_policy.lod0: Retain porch columns, quarter-wall, asymmetric west openings, rear screening rhythm and log/chinking relief.
lod_policy.lod1: Retain both shed porches, primary door/window masses and side-gable profile.
lod_policy.lod2: Retain central gable plus both full-length shed silhouettes.

structures.measurement_policy: Read dimensions and pitch from the HABS sheets; do not estimate them from perspective photographs.

structures.name: Andy Chambers stable/barn
structures.historical_relationship: The original 1912 log stable is understood to survive in the evolved central barn component.

form.plan: Central log gambrel component with a later northward gambrel extension and one full west-elevation shed-roof frame addition.
form.walls: Square-notched logs in the southern core, axe-cut steeple notches in the northern addition, half-pole chinking, and eleven-inch board-and-batten on gable ends and west shed.
form.roof: Gambrel roof plus a single west shed, all clad in galvanized metal panels over vertical planks.
form.front: South elevation with hay hood, centered gambrel hay door, two small stall openings and a large shed sliding door.

recognition_cues: Gambrel central mass with only one west shed
Slight eave break and settlement where the northern addition meets the original component
Log lower walls and board-and-batten gable ends
Four shuttered openings beneath the west shed eave

lod_policy.lod0: Retain hay hood, single west shed, eave break, principal doors, shutters, mixed notch zones and log/chinking relief.
lod_policy.lod1: Retain gambrel, west shed, hay hood and broad door masses.
lod_policy.lod2: Retain the asymmetric gambrel-plus-one-shed silhouette; never substitute the two-shed T. A. or John Moulton form.

structures.measurement_policy: Use registered plan mapping and building-class LiDAR for envelope dimensions, then documentary descriptions for architectural decomposition.

structures.name: Chambers 1946 generator windmill

form.type: Open metal lattice tower with rotor and tail vane.
form.function: Powered a private electrical generator before Rural Electrification Administration service.

recognition_cues: Readable rotor disc and tail vane
Slender silhouette visible above the low agricultural cluster

lod_policy.lod0: Use efficient lattice geometry, a simplified rotor and a tail vane; no opaque projected tower.
lod_policy.lod1: Reduce lattice diagonals while retaining tower taper, rotor and vane.
lod_policy.lod2: Use a minimal open tower silhouette plus crossed rotor card or low-poly rotor.

structures.measurement_policy: Derive tower base, height and rotor diameter from registered mapping and LiDAR/photographic scale only after identity is resolved.
structures.release_gate: Prove the windmill belongs in the Andy candidate transform set and is not the adjacent Roy Chambers #RCST-1 structure.

cluster_rules.coordinate_space: Structure transforms are local to a surveyed EPSG:32612 cluster anchor.
cluster_rules.grounding: Sample terrain independently beneath every structure; preserve visible foundation type and do not flatten the entire cluster.
cluster_rules.setting: Keep Mormon Row Road, Ditch Creek, service road, corrals, fence divisions and cleared pasture legible.
cluster_rules.vegetation: Use per-structure clearance footprints with a small irregular margin; do not create one broad cluster exclusion zone.
cluster_rules.materials: Share calibrated material families and packed atlases, but keep façade projections structure-specific.

known_uncertainties: Exact building dimensions and relative transforms have not yet been transcribed from measured drawings or derived from LiDAR.
The stable-to-barn construction chronology is documented, but individual phase boundaries require drawing review.
The windmill identity and ownership across the Andy/Roy Chambers site boundary remain unresolved.
Current preservation condition must be checked against recent NPS imagery before modeling settled or missing fabric.
